title: Pullback of the complete diagonal coefficient family
statement: Let two families be as in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams], over Noetherian bases $Y,Y'$, and let $g:Y'\to Y$. Their family-pullback property consists of pullback compatibilities in the sense of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-pullback] at the $\mathbf Z_\ell$, all $\mathcal O_E$, all $E$ and algebraic-closure stages. The integral line maps are exactly the root-projection comparisons of [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients]; the rational comparisons are normalized on balanced tensor generators and the closure comparisons on every finite-field coprojection, using that same recorded comparison. The required residue-field invertibility witnesses are retained as part of the data. For every maximal-ideal generator, every positive uniformizer quotient, and any quotient diagrams scalar-compatible with the two integral family members, there are quotient line pullback maps and a pullback compatibility of those diagrams. Each quotient line map is fixed on all balanced tensor generators by the actual coefficient pullback and the integral root comparison. Thus its class and trace squares use precisely the canonical mates and generator-normalized maps of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-pullback]; no preservation of arbitrary inverse limits is asserted.
